soundness_flags.label: def:minimax-width and thm:sharp-rank-frontier
soundness_flags.one_line: The infimum is evaluated at a finite sample-size triple over bands constrained only by an asymptotic liminf-honesty condition, so for any fixed triple a candidate sequence can be made zero-width and dishonest only there while remaining uniformly honest asymptotically; consequently the displayed finite-n minimax width is not a valid lower-bound target.

soundness_flags.label: def:exact-rank-class, def:canonical-factorization, and thm:attaining-band
soundness_flags.one_line: The class never imposes exact donor-centered contrast rank d or a lower donor-loading Gram bound, yet the canonical eigendecomposition rescales donor loadings to covariance I_d and the FPCR estimator retains d contrasts; admissible lower-effective-rank panels therefore make those constructions undefined.

source_verification_receipts.locator: pp. 9--10, Assumption 6 and Theorem 1; p. 10, Assumptions 7--8 and Theorem 2; p. 14, bootstrap paragraph
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper assumes latent-factor linear-span inclusion for identification, gives a finite-grid SSC consistency theorem under K exceeding a max{N0,T0}-dependent logarithmic threshold, and reports 500 donor-pool bootstrap resamples in its application.

source_verification_receipts.version: Journal of Machine Learning Research 26(117), published June 2025
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: Theorem 4.1 identifies the minimum-norm PCR coefficient under a signal-to-noise condition; Theorem 4.2 bounds out-of-sample prediction error, with row-space inclusion stated separately as Assumption 4.2.

The article develops martingale-based multiplier resampling and asymptotically valid time-simultaneous confidence bands for cumulative hazards in Cox/multistate models with right censoring or left truncation.

source_verification_receipts.version: Journal of the American Statistical Association 116(536), 2021
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper develops conditional synthetic-control prediction intervals and separates uncertainty from pretreatment weight construction from post-treatment prediction error, combining component probability bounds in Lemma 1.
The article studies honest adaptive confidence sets and related composite testing problems for low-rank matrix completion in trace-regression and Bernoulli observation experiments.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Replace the pointwise infimum over asymptotically honest sequences with either a finite-n uniform coverage requirement or an asymptotic minimax functional that evaluates width and coverage jointly over a single sequence of bands; then restate both Le Cam lower bounds against that repaired object.

Add primitive exact-rank geometry: a donor-centered loading Gram lower and upper bound (or equivalent nonzero singular-value bounds for the centered donor survival operator), explicitly require rank d, and make the canonical normalization a consequence of those conditions.

Add a worked rank-two survival-law pair satisfying the repaired class conditions and calculate its target-loading perturbation, likelihood divergence, and endpoint normalization; this would make the lower-bound route auditable and strengthen the flagship construction.

recommended_next_step: Revise the minimax definition and exact-rank/donor-strength class before Stage 0; the repaired two-channel frontier remains a plausible flagship target.
